title: Compiling and Optimizing Scripting Languages
summary: Paul Biggar's Google Tech Talk on compiling and optimizing scripting languages, drawn from his work on the phc ahead-of-time PHP compiler. He covers runtime typing, aliasing and code generation challenges, and argues AOT can compete with JIT.
why: Cited in PHP compiler and language-implementation discussions as an honest account of the real difficulties of compiling dynamic languages.

quote.text: Some great examples of disappointments and challenges!
